avis.titre: Best Toner I Have Ever Used
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Whenever I try a new skincare product, I look for two things: 1. Is it going to irritate my extremely sensitive skin? 2. Despite the warning in the instructions, I didn't experience any redness, burning, or rashes (which, when my skin reacts to anything with chemical SPF or fragrance in it, this is a HUGE win). On top of that, this smells delightfully refreshing with just its natural ingredients - no fragrance needed to get this delicious cucumber scent! And, it's really easy to use because of the pour/dropped spout lid. No pesky pump or nozzle to deal with, I only need to gently lean it over to get my skin's daily five drops of this toner. And because I only need a little bit each day, this will last me for months if not a full year! As previously noted, my skin is super finicky, and that includes random acne flair ups. When I first started using this (and all the way through the first month of use), I was going through an acne flair up. While this didn't make my flair up go away faster than usual, once it did go away, my skin was glowier, smoother, and more even. I will definitely continue to use this up, but will need to do some more before and after comparisons to see how much of a benefit it provided. That being said, this is by far the best toner I've ever used, and with its
